experiment_data.hypothesis: Per-layer KL training (each step masks only 1 random layer independently) will produce significantly worse PPL than end-to-end KL (8.81) when all 32 masks are applied simultaneously at inference, quantifying the value of cross-layer coupling in joint optimization. Restart with intermediate checkpointing to prevent progress loss from timeout kills.
